answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the violet of the next round.
